# Tooltip (`tooltip`)

Short hint on hover or focus.

Group: Overlays. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/overlays';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createIconButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/iconButton.d.ts`): `.mh-icon-button`: a round, icon-only button at least a touch target wide.

```ts
export function createIconButton(options: IconButtonOptions): IconButtonHandle;

export interface IconButtonOptions {
  icon: IconName | string;
  /** Required: the button's accessible name (also its tooltip). */
  label: string;
  tone?: IconButtonTone;
  size?: IconButtonSize;
  /** A filled circle (raised surface) rather than a bare glyph. */
  filled?: boolean;
  /** Toggle buttons: sets `aria-pressed`. */
  pressed?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface IconButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setIcon(icon: IconName | string): void;
  setPressed(pressed: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createTooltip` (types in `dist/web/overlays/tooltip.d.ts`): `.mh-tooltip` (`role="tooltip"`): a short hint for `target`, shown on hover (after `delay`) and on keyboard focus,hidden on leave, blur or Escape. The pointer can move onto the hint without it vanishing. The target gets`aria-describedby` unless its accessible name already says the same; its `title` is held back meanwhile so thebrowser's own tooltip doesn't double it.

```ts
export function createTooltip(target: HTMLElement, options: TooltipOptions): TooltipHandle;

export interface TooltipOptions {
  text: string;
  /** Default `top`; flips when there's no room. */
  placement?: TooltipPlacement;
  /** Hover delay in ms before showing. Default 500. Focus shows it at once. */
  delay?: number;
  /** Portals into the nearest `[data-mh-theme]` ancestor of this element (default: the target's). */
  container?: HTMLElement | null;
}

export interface TooltipHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  show(): void;
  hide(): void;
  setText(text: string): void;
  /** Removes the tooltip and its listeners, restoring the target's attributes. */
  destroy(): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createIconButton, createTooltip } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

let refreshed = 0;

const refresh = createIconButton({
  icon: 'refresh',
  label: 'Refresh',
  onClick: () => {
    refreshed += 1;
    tooltip.setText(`Refreshed ${refreshed} ${refreshed === 1 ? 'time' : 'times'}`);
  },
});

const tooltip = createTooltip(refresh.el, { text: 'Refresh the device list', placement: 'bottom' });

document.body.append(refresh.el);
```

## React API

`IconButton` (types in `dist/react/actions.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createIconButton`.

```ts
export function IconButton({ icon, label, tone, size, filled, pressed, className, ...rest }: IconButtonProps);

export interface IconButtonProps extends Omit<ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'children'> {
  icon: IconName | string;
  /** Required: the accessible name (also the tooltip). */
  label: string;
  tone?: IconButtonTone;
  size?: IconButtonSize;
  filled?: boolean;
  pressed?: boolean;
}
```

`Tooltip` (types in `dist/react/overlays.d.ts`): `createTooltip` on its child. The wrapper is `display: contents`.

```ts
export function Tooltip({ text, placement, delay, children }: TooltipProps);

export interface TooltipProps {
  text: string;
  placement?: TooltipPlacement;
  delay?: number;
  /** The element the hint describes: one focusable element. */
  children: ReactElement;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { IconButton, Tooltip } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function TooltipExample() {
  const [refreshed, setRefreshed] = useState(0);
  const text = refreshed === 0 ? 'Refresh the device list' : `Refreshed ${refreshed} ${refreshed === 1 ? 'time' : 'times'}`;
  return (
    <Tooltip text={text} placement="bottom">
      <IconButton icon="refresh" label="Refresh" onClick={() => setRefreshed((n) => n + 1)} />
    </Tooltip>
  );
}
```
